name: drupal/literals
description: Exact values (phone numbers, URLs, names) kept as governed literals: audience-based access, a [literal:key] token, search, and an optional model-assisted lookup by question.

suggest.drupal/ai: ^1.4. Required by literals_finder: the Decision API chooser (find a literal by plain-language question) and Guardrails checks at save. A decision provider module (Ollama, Anthropic, ...) must also be configured.
suggest.drupal/tool: ^1.0@beta. Required by literals_tool, which exposes literals:lookup (key, search, and question modes) over Tool API.
suggest.drupal/mcp_server_tool_bridge: Exposes literals_tool's literals:lookup to MCP clients.
suggest.drupal/token: Adds a token browser to the value field of token-type literals.
suggest.drupal/gin: Gives the literal edit form a node-style sidebar layout.
